articles.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
articles.title: Local Molecular Motions Encode Time-Resolved Infrared Spectra of Proteins
articles.short: IR spectra linked to protein motions
articles.headline: IR relaxation times assigned to contact motions
articles.did: We **combined transient infrared spectroscopy** with **nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulations** to connect experimental relaxation times to local **inter‑residue contact distances**.
articles.why: **Contact‑distance networks** capture coordinated motions that mediate long‑range **allosteric coupling**, allowing each kinetic step to be assigned to a specific molecular motion.

term.def: Distance between specific atom pairs of two residues used to monitor structural changes in proteins.

articles.title: Linkage Hydrophosphonylation-Mediated Fabrication of Hollow Phosphonic Acid-Functionalized Covalent Organic Frameworks for Highly Efficient Enrichment and Detection of Organochlorine Pesticides
articles.short: Hollow COFs with phosphonic acid for OCP capture
articles.headline: Hollow COF with H2PO3 achieves 0.5 ng L⁻¹ OCP detection
articles.did: The study **converts imine bonds into α‑aminophosphonic acid linkages** via linkage hydrophosphonylation, **forming hollow COF spheres with H2PO3 groups in a single step**.
articles.why: The hollow structure **increases surface area and shortens mass‑transfer pathways**, while H2PO3 sites provide **multiple non‑covalent interactions** (van der Waals, π‑π, hydrogen‑bond, dipole, halogen), yielding rapid, high‑affinity OCP capture and sub‑ng L⁻¹ detection.

term.def: A reaction that cleaves imine bonds and installs α‑aminophosphonic acid groups, converting linkages in a polymer framework.

articles.title: Dual-Channel Cell Membrane Probe for Simultaneously Detecting ONOO− and Viscosity of Tumor Cell Membranes and In Vivo Tumor Imaging
articles.headline: Mem‑OV gives 734 nm & 514 nm for ONOO− and viscosity
articles.did: The probe Mem‑OV **rapidly turns on fluorescence at 734 nm for viscosity** and **at 514 nm for ONOO−**, with no channel crosstalk and strong membrane localization.
articles.why: Because Mem‑OV **simultaneously visualizes viscosity and ONOO− at the membrane**, it can track ferroptosis dynamics, differentiate tumor from normal cells, and be applied in vivo through injection.

term.def: Peroxynitrite, a reactive nitrogen species formed from superoxide and nitric oxide, often elevated in oxidative stress.

articles.title: A Self-Powered Triboelectric Nanogenerator-Driven Biosensing Platform Integrating Aptamer- or CRISPR-Based Nanohydrogels for Circulating Tumor Biomarker Detection
inst: The Affiliated Xuzhou Municipal Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University

rors.name: The Affiliated Xuzhou Municipal Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University

articles.short: Self-powered TENG biosensor for tumor markers
articles.headline: Detects CTCs at 10 cells/mL; miR‑21 LOD 4.12×10⁻¹³ M
articles.did: We built a **vertical‑contact‑separation triboelectric nanogenerator** that powers a biosensor incorporating **aptamer‑or CRISPR‑based nanohydrogels**, MWCNTs and NiPt nanoparticles for voltage‑modulated detection of circulating tumor biomarkers.
articles.why: Self‑powered operation removes external power needs, while voltage readout with a multimeter offers simple, quantitative analysis; the platform reaches **10 cells/mL CTC detection** and 4.12×10⁻¹³ M miR‑21 LOD, supporting point‑of‑care cancer monitoring.

term.def: A device that converts mechanical motion into electrical energy via contact‑induced charge separation.

articles.title: A Low-Cost Non-FRET Reporter System Empowers CRISPR/Cas12a Based Detection
inst: Nanjing University of Finance and Economics
Shenzhen Research Institute of City University of Hong Kong

rors.name: Nanjing University of Finance and Economics
Shenzhen Research Institute of City University of Hong Kong

articles.headline: CRISPR/Cas12a assay detects mecA at 213 fM
articles.did: We developed an **amplification‑free, label‑free CRISPR/Cas12a biosensing platform** that uses **DNA‑templated copper nanoclusters (DNA‑CuNCs) as fluorescent reporters** together with exonuclease III and a rationally designed AT‑rich DNA template.
articles.why: The method offers **low‑cost, high signal‑to‑background fluorescence** without amplification, enabling **point‑of‑care testing on ice** and accurate detection of antibiotic‑resistance genes in environmental samples.

term.def: Fluorescent copper nanoclusters formed on a DNA scaffold, whose emission depends on the DNA sequence and structure.

articles.title: An asymmetric quartz tuning fork for enhanced localized photothermal excitation in light-induced thermoelastic spectroscopy sensing
articles.headline: Asymmetric quartz fork boosts photothermal excitation
articles.did: Designed an asymmetric quartz tuning fork that **enhances localized photothermal excitation** for **light‑induced thermoelastic spectroscopy** sensing.
articles.why: The design aims to provide **enhanced localized photothermal excitation** for **light‑induced thermoelastic spectroscopy**.

term.def: Thermoelastic spectroscopy: technique measuring material deformation caused by temperature changes induced by light absorption.
